title: Question
description: A gap, contradiction or 'why' that only a person can settle. Raised by analysis, a run or a review; answered by a person. The answer is a told source and goes back through Capture. Distil phase (raised), Capture phase (answered).

text.description: One question, answerable by the person asked.

why.description: What prompted it, in one or two sentences.

kind.description: gap = nothing says. contradiction = the evidence disagrees with itself. intent = we see what, not why. exception = is this case an exception or a mistake? scope = where does it apply? confirm = is this candidate rule right?

askedOf.description: The role who can answer: 'standards owner', 'family author', 'BIM manager'.

options.description: Likely answers, when they help the person answer quickly. Always allow a free answer.

relatesTo.description: Rules, outcomes, steps or jobs the answer affects.

source.description: The told source (SRC-) where the answer is recorded.
